xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4786: Adopted PRs always fail verification on incomplete-plan-items (no xBRIEF); supervised handoff PRs can never be reviewed

plan.title: Adopted PRs always fail verification on incomplete-plan-items (no xBRIEF); supervised handoff PRs can never be reviewed
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: A PR adopted into a pipeline workspace (PAN-4605: a supervised pan handoff conversation, an operator conversation, a contributor) has no xBRIEF, so the plan checklist gate (verification-runner.ts lines 816-818, checkIncompletePlanItems) always fails with failedCheck 'incomplete-plan-items'. Only strike merges set skipPlanChecklist. On 2026-11-02 PR #4780 (PAN-4750) and #4783 (PAN-4772) were adopted and both failed this way, so no supervised-handoff PR can be reviewed.
narratives.Proposal: Add src/lib/cloister/adopted-plan-checklist.ts with isAdoptedWorkspaceWithoutPlan (journal has any workspace.adopted entry AND findPlan resolves null) and withAdoptedPlanChecklistSkip (adds skipPlanChecklist: true to the caller's options in that case; keeps an explicit true; fails closed on plan-read errors). Call it inside runVerificationForIssue (verification-runner.ts line 984), the door every production verification uses (review request, /trigger, merge-verify), so the existing skipPlanChecklist option reaches the worker options on every run, not only the first run after adoption. Document the skip in docs/PIPELINE-GATES.md and docs/MERGE-WORKFLOW.md. See .pan/drafts/pan-4786.md for exact code. Also make the live-worker join in runSupervisedVerificationOnce require sameOptions, so a worker launched with other options is replaced rather than joined.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to pan done preflight (runPreflightChecks) or POST /api/agents/:id/runtime-events; both still call checkIncompletePlanItems.
- No synthetic xBRIEF generation for adopted PRs.
- No new option, flag, journal entry type, or second skip mechanism; skipPlanChecklist is the only skip.
- No change to RequestReviewStarter, pr-adoption-review.ts, merge-strike.ts, done-preflight.ts, or the verification worker request shape.
- A workspace created by hand with pan workspace create (no workspace.adopted entry) keeps the checklist.
- Remote (Fly) workspaces are never treated as adopted.
- Re-running verification for PR #4780 and #4783 after deploy is an operator step, not code.
- No allowlist raise in scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt.
- The in-process activeSupervisorRuns coalescing map in verification-worker-supervisor.ts is not made option-sensitive.
- No async twin of readPipelineJournal.

autoDecisions.summary: Decide the skip from workspace state inside runVerificationForIssue, not only in the adoption review starter.
autoDecisions.rationale: Adoption runs once. A later pan review request, the /trigger route, or merge verification (merge-ops.ts line 1021) would run the checklist again and fail. The issue's own condition (journal has workspace.adopted and no xBRIEF) is workspace state, and resolving it at the one verification door still threads it through the existing skipPlanChecklist option into the worker options, as the issue asks.

autoDecisions.summary: Place the resolution in the runVerificationForIssue wrapper only (no line-816 variant).
autoDecisions.rationale: The wrapper sets the option before runSupervisedVerification persists it and before the supervisor's option checks, so the effective option is visible in the worker state. verification-runner.ts is 994 lines and its allowlist cap (961) applies above 1000, so the edit adds at most 4 lines (998); if main grows, the seven-line JSDoc above the wrapper is shortened to one line instead of raising the allowlist.

autoDecisions.summary: Count any workspace.adopted entry, not only the last journal entry.
autoDecisions.rationale: After adoption the journal gains review.requested, verification.failed and others; the workspace is still the adopted one, so later runs must get the same answer.

autoDecisions.summary: Fail closed when findPlan errors: keep the checklist.
autoDecisions.rationale: An unreadable plan location is not proof that no xBRIEF exists; the checklist then reports the read error exactly as it does today.

autoDecisions.summary: Make the cross-process live-worker join option-sensitive; leave the in-process activeSupervisorRuns map unchanged.
autoDecisions.rationale: Plan critique round 1: a live worker launched without skipPlanChecklist (e.g. re-attached on boot) would otherwise be joined by a post-fix request and fail the adopted PR again. adoptUnconsumedResult already uses sameOptions; the live join gets the same rule. The in-process map is only reached by a merge verification racing a review verification, because requestReviewPipeline coalesces review requests first.

autoDecisions.summary: Accept synchronous readPipelineJournal in the async helper (NFR-2 revised).
autoDecisions.rationale: Small local file read once per verification, the same pattern every journal reader uses; an async twin would violate the one-variant-per-operation rule.

metadata.sizeJustification: Four small items touching three source files, three tests and two docs.

items.title: Add the adopted-workspace plan checklist helper module

narrative.Action: Create src/lib/cloister/adopted-plan-checklist.ts exactly as in PRD work item W1: export async isAdoptedWorkspaceWithoutPlan(workspacePath) = readPipelineJournal(workspacePath).some(e => e.type === 'workspace.adopted') && (await Effect.runPromise(findPlan(workspacePath).pipe(Effect.orElseSucceed(() => 'unreadable')))) === null; and export async withAdoptedPlanChecklistSkip(workspacePath, options) that returns options unchanged when options.skipPlanChecklist is already true (no reads), returns { ...options, skipPlanChecklist: true } plus one console.log line '[verification] <workspacePath>: adopted PR workspace with no xBRIEF — skipping the plan checklist (PAN-4786)' when isAdoptedWorkspaceWithoutPlan is true, and otherwise returns options unchanged. Update the skipPlanChecklist doc comment in src/lib/cloister/verification-types.ts line 24 to name both strike workspaces and adopted PR workspaces with no xBRIEF (PAN-4786). Write tests/unit/lib/cloister/adopted-plan-checklist.test.ts with the seven cases listed in PRD W1, using a mkdtemp tree <root>/workspaces/feature-pan-9001 and journal lines written directly to <ws>/.overdeck/pipeline.jsonl. Do not modify pipeline-journal.ts or xbrief/io.ts.

items.title: Given a temp workspace whose journal holds a workspace.adopted entry and no xBRIEF exists in the workspace, the main checkout, or a workspace draft, when withAdoptedPlanChecklistSkip(ws, {}) runs, then it returns { skipPlanChecklist: true }

Given an adopted temp workspace with a spec file .pan/specs/2026-11-01-PAN-9001-adopted.xbrief.json in either the workspace or the main checkout, when withAdoptedPlanChecklistSkip(ws, {}) runs, then it returns options without skipPlanChecklist
Given a workspace whose journal is missing or holds no workspace.adopted entry, when withAdoptedPlanChecklistSkip(ws, {}) runs, then it returns options without skipPlanChecklist

Given options { skipPlanChecklist: true, syncTargetBranch: false } and a nonexistent workspace path, when withAdoptedPlanChecklistSkip runs, then it returns the same object identity (toBe) without reading the journal

Given a journal where workspace.adopted is followed by review.requested and verification.failed entries and no xBRIEF exists, when withAdoptedPlanChecklistSkip(ws, {}) runs, then it returns { skipPlanChecklist: true }
Resolve skipPlanChecklist for adopted workspaces in runVerificationForIssue

Join a live verification worker only when its options match

expected_outputs: verification-worker-supervisor-join.test.ts passes, including the new 'running with other options' case

narrative.Action: In runSupervisedVerificationOnce (src/lib/cloister/verification-worker-supervisor.ts lines ~327-341) apply the PRD W2b before/after: compute `const sameRun = sameHead && sameOptions(existing.options, options);`, join the live worker only when sameRun and the deadline has not passed, and set `reason` to 'for a different workspace HEAD' when !sameHead, 'running with other options' when !sameRun, else 'past its deadline'. The kill-and-fresh-start path below stays as is. Do not change the activeSupervisorRuns map or adoptUnconsumedResult. Add one test to src/lib/cloister/__tests__/verification-worker-supervisor-join.test.ts in describe('review verification join rule (PAN-4527)'), modelled on 'kills a worker launched on head A...': registerLiveWorker(commit('a'), { logPrefix: 'request-review', options: {} }), then runSupervisedVerification('PAN-1', mocks.workspace, { isRemote: false }, 'request-review', { skipPlanChecklist: true }).

items.title: Given a live request-review worker registered with options {} on the current head, when runSupervisedVerification runs with { skipPlanChecklist: true }, then it sends SIGTERM to the live worker's process group (signalled equals [{ pid: -LIVE_PID, signal: 'SIGTERM' }]) and launches exactly one fresh worker
